output.reason: On its own, the cited table-of-contents line [ev-c929ea305a6b] is too vague, but the upgrade-guide section it links to [ev-e2dcb3e0ebe6] states the change concretely. Composite resources (XRs) no longer have native connection details support, so the change is a removal. Only XRs are affected: managed resources keep the `writeConnectionSecretToRef` field. That gives applicability: environments whose XRs depend on native connection details. Operators can recreate the feature by composing their own connection details `Secret`. The section does not say exactly how leftover XR connection-detail settings behave at runtime (ignored or rejected), but it supports a typed consequence of feature loss with a manual replacement.
